question: Can a read-only audit of the sealed V2 candidates recover the scientifically correct 100-parent recipe-stratified split without regenerating topology?
method: Verify all 391 sealed V2 evidence hashes, read exactly 120 frozen candidate metric records, require every non-exact-cycle source contract plus cycle_rank >= requested connector count, treat requested grown/connector counts as generation recipe metadata and observed cycle rank as graph GT, select fixed C01-C10 in each of ten recipe strata, and split C01-C08/C09/C10 as 80 train/10 validation/10 development-test. Generate no topology, replay, graph, spline, preview, mesh, LiDAR, label, dataset sample, model or trajectory.
baseline: The sealed V2 run generated and replayed 120/120 candidates but retained only 99 because an invalid exact-cycle family rule rejected six candidates whose grown tunnels created one additional natural cycle. A frozen read-only counterfactual over the same records yields 120 recipe-valid candidates and a fixed 100-parent 80/10/10 split.

user_authorization.scope: One read-only V2R audit over 120 sealed V2 candidates using recipe strata, observed cycle rank as GT, fixed C01-C10 selection and an 80/10/10 parent split; zero topology generation, replay, preview, mesh, LiDAR, labels, formal data and training.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续干 after receiving the exact zero-generation, read-only recipe-reclassification, fixed C01-C10, 100-parent/80-10-10 and zero mesh/LiDAR/training V2R scope.

acceptance_criteria: Approved proposal/card, all frozen implementation hashes, the five frozen source identities and all 391 sealed V2 evidence hashes match before RUNNING.
Exactly 120 sealed candidates are read; no topology construction, same-seed replay, graph, spline or preview is created.
Every candidate passes all non-exact-cycle source contracts and has actual cycle rank greater than or equal to requested connector count.
Fixed C01-C10 selection yields exactly 10 parents per recipe stratum and exactly 80 train, 10 validation and 10 development-test parents.
The selected 100 parents have 100 unique canonical identities, 100 unique coordinate-free WL hashes, 100 structural-event parents and 50 3D parents.
Exactly three artifact manifests, two executor metric summaries and one runner summary are produced; no preview is rendered and total output remains below 10 MiB.
Mesh, LiDAR, teacher-label, formal-data, training, model, trajectory and M-TARE counts remain zero.
stop_conditions: Any approval, frozen tool, frozen source, source seal, source status, candidate count, scope or output-state mismatch
Any candidate fails a non-exact-cycle source contract or has actual cycle rank below its requested connector count
Any recipe stratum lacks C01-C10 or any identity/split/count acceptance criterion fails
Continuation would require regenerating topology, selecting by observed cycle rank, changing the fixed split or inspecting validation/development-test previews
The executor exceeds 60 seconds or the result exceeds 10 MiB
expected_evidence: Frozen implementation and source hashes, all-source-seal verification, exact command, log, duration, exit code and immutable RUN_STATE
A 120-candidate recipe audit manifest recording requested recipe and observed graph cycle rank
A fixed 100-parent accepted manifest and parent-disjoint 80/10/10 split manifest
Machine summaries proving identity diversity, structure/3D counts and all zero-scope boundaries
A complete SHA-256 evidence manifest with no generated preview

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only frozen E1 CPU JSON and SHA-256 audit; no Cano generation, mesh, raycasting, simulator or training.
